**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a mixed lunch or dinner laid out on two trays on a white table, photographed from above at a slight angle. A colour calibration card and a sample label (3102) are in view. Food sits on two rows of trays: the left tray has a hot-food spread and the right has salads and chicken. Drinks sit at the back.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The side plates are white disposable plates of about 20 cm diameter (area ~314 cm²). The salad bowl is about 15 cm (~177 cm²). The calibration card (~5 cm wide) confirms the scale.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Shrimp in red sauce; quiche/tart; stir-fried rice or vegetables; a small cup of dressing or sauce; mixed green salad in a bowl; shredded chicken; mushroom and leaf salad; orange juice; a yellow drink (lemonade-type); iced coffee; water (0 kcal, not counted).

**STEP 4 - Area:** Shrimp ~12% of a 20 cm plate; quiche ~50% (a 15 cm tart); stir-fry ~25%; dressing cup is tiny; salad bowl greens ~60% of the bowl; chicken ~30%; mushroom salad ~60% of its dish.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Shrimp ~38 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 75 ml. Quiche ~154 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 385 ml. Stir-fry ~78 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 157 ml. Salad greens ~106 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 318 ml. Chicken ~94 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 113 ml. Mushroom salad ~121 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 242 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Shrimp 75 ml × 0.9 ≈ 68 g. Quiche ≈ 200 g (pastry is airy, so below full density). Stir-fry 157 ml × 0.7 ≈ 110 g. Dressing ~10 g. Leafy greens 318 ml × 0.15 ≈ 48 g. Chicken 113 ml × 0.9 ≈ 90 g. Mushroom salad 242 ml × 0.25 ≈ 60 g. Drinks: orange juice ~250 g, yellow drink ~200 g, iced coffee ~250 g (glass and jar volumes).

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Shrimp in sauce 100 kcal/100 g; quiche 280; stir-fry 130; dressing 80; leaves 20; chicken 165; mushroom salad 40; orange juice 45; yellow drink 40; iced coffee with milk ~40.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 1.3 kg in total, with about 1,250 kcal. That is plausible for a full lunch spread with two trays of food and three drinks. The quiche and drinks are the largest contributors. Values are rough estimates.
